metric: planBefore/planAfter pairs from Calcite's current rule tests, translated to SQL, proved equivalent; 1 genuine Calcite non-equivalence refuted with a DuckDB counterexample, 233 unknown. 53 of the 168 pairs new to every other corpus are proved.

correctness: 0 false proofs; every proof and refutation re-run on 60 random DuckDB databases, half skewed towards the literals
